_meta.purpose: A PUBLIC map: therapeutic class → which laboratory values to monitor while taking it. For a personal assessment: the application checks this against the patient's LAB RESULTS and highlights the deviations that are already there. Portable, without patient data.
_meta.note: labs — keys from labs.json (what we actually track). why — why it is monitored on this class.
_meta.note_nutraceutical_layer_20260813: Monitoring tests have been added for the nutraceutical classes; statin (+CK), testosterone_replacement (+haematocrit, testosterone, DHT) and azole_antifungal (+CK) have been strengthened.

why.en: at doses above the tolerable upper intake level (IOM 4000 IU/day) — blood calcium, ionised calcium and PTH, not 25-OH D alone
why.ru: на дозах выше верхнего допустимого уровня (IOM 4000 МЕ/сут) — кальций крови, ионизированный кальций и ПТГ, а не только сам 25-OH D

why.en: TSH, free T4 and anti-TPO antibodies 6–8 weeks after a change in the iodine dose; the tolerable upper level is 1100 µg/day (US) and 600 µg/day (EFSA)

why.en: pyridoxal phosphate with long-term use; EFSA lowered the tolerable upper level from 25 to 12 mg/day (2023) — the toxicity is a sensory neuropathy
